answer: Each identity files one glacier relic record in both the glacier ledger and the anchor ledger. Each filing is sealed under the applicant key, entered once per ledger, with a 70 bond. An auditor cross-checks the two records: same relic serial, same key, same origin; mismatch, reuse, or a foreign seal burns the bond. First costs 33, the k-th 33+7(k-1), the 1000th 7026, so 1000 fakes pay 3,529,500 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-record ring fails: a rented record keeps the renter key in one ledger and cannot match the borrower key in the other. Honest filers pay 33 once, bond back after one epoch.
